simulator.note: Boots as C3505 with 128 MB DDR3 (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_piccollino_s2_app_starts.py, run_dump_piccollino_s2_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, copies itself to 0x81000000, writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), shows the boot logo through VideoOutputM36F, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80002000 / 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initializes MultiCAS ("[mcas] max_key_db_count = 505"), and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD dialog through the display engine at 0xB8006900 (5 GE commands, 14 colours).

desc: Edision Piccollino S2 (System ID 6B000100) firmware v.1375 (2019-07-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3521A / C3505 Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver with 128 MB DDR3.
Pairs dual-CPU C3505 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200) with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON " -> " on ") and a 60-entry 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
